title: Trip cancellation and refund
description: Confirm a cancelled booking on WhatsApp with refund amount and timing. Utility template for hotels, airlines and tour operators.
notes: State the refund amount and expected days to arrive; vague refund copy drives support tickets.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your booking *{{booking_ref}}* has been cancelled as requested. A refund of {{refund}} will go to your original payment method within {{days}} business days.
